summary: The config-files group has 392 rows in five partitions: system_a 270, system_ext_a 73, vendor_a 28, odm_a 11, product_a 10 (389 regular files, 3 symlinks). It holds 123 trust-anchor PEM certificates (system_a security/cacerts, each file named by its OpenSSL subject hash), 41 compiled terminfo entries, 37 hyphenation licence texts, five gzipped NOTICE indices, 38 zip-container model archives (.ptl, .pt, .jit), four ExecuTorch program files (.pte, .ff) and three octet-stream .ptl models for body, hand, face, input, object, IoT, passive-tracking, wake-word, depth and audio features, plus runtime configuration read by init, the process-group library, the dynamic linker, the font stack, the camera and audio HALs, the OpenXR loader and the telemetry services. Binary items include two eBPF objects (netd.o, clatd.o), an AArch64 PIE helper (ip-up-vpn), a Cap'n Proto HMD configuration, a binary linker namespace protobuf and an fs_config directory table. Every row's file is present with the recorded sha256. The 15 deep-dive items give format facts, keys and literal or SELinux references found in the mounted image.
